title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Mamunur Rashid…
description: A stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Mamunur Rashid Team software versions up to 6.0.6. This vulnerability results from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing malicious scripts to be stored and executed in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level with potential impacts on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
